description: Verify that TCP in LISTEN state sends a SYN,ACK in response to a received SYN (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
LISTEN's defining behaviour: respond to an incoming SYN with SYN,ACK to begin the 3-way handshake. This is the entry transition LISTEN → SYN-RCVD.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted SYN,ACK observed within the listen window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN,ACK within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied with SYN,ACK from LISTEN — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
